acceptanceResults: Scheduled only is never Confirmed and resolves as Scheduled or PendingConfirmation according to the existing observation date boundary.
SEC EarningsRelated evidence can resolve Confirmed; QuarterlyReport or AnnualReport alone remains Filing and cannot be treated as Earnings.
Alpha-only evidence remains expected/scheduled and cannot resolve Confirmed.
Finnhub-only evidence remains AggregatorObserved/PendingConfirmation and cannot cross the official-evidence boundary.
Conflicting provider dates are retained as separate evidence and produce a conflict diagnostic without guessing a winning date.
Expected and official evidence are both retained; official confirmation records confirmed date/time separately from expected date.
External structured enrichment such as theme and importance is retained with provenance and is not overwritten by generic provider facts; absent enrichment does not infer theme from symbol.
Evidence visibility uses observed_at, accepted_at, and report_run_at; evidence learned after report_run_at is excluded from the snapshot.
Provider health distinguishes Healthy, Partial, Stale, and Unavailable; provider failure is not represented as No Event.
Resolver output is observation/diagnostic only and Decision, Gate, Leader, Action Matrix, Position Sizing, and Execution remain semantic-equivalent.
NVIDIA lifecycle regression covers expected tomorrow, pre-release PendingConfirmation, official post-release Confirmed, and T+1 Historical/Confirmed without back-writing pre-release visibility.
Required provider evidence and health are rendered in the daily report appendix without leaking API credentials.
All provider failures, malformed inputs, unknown symbols, excessive/future timestamps, and oversized/untraceable evidence fail closed.
